body.raw:
{
  "model": "mistral:latest",
  "prompt": "Create a detailed description and metadata for this task: '{{ $json.title }}'

Provide:
1. A clear 2-3 sentence description explaining what this task involves
2. A complexity score from 1-5 (1=very easy, 5=very complex)
3. Three relevant tags

Respond in this exact JSON format:
{
  "description": "Your detailed description here",
  "complexity": 3,
  "tags": ["tag1", "tag2", "tag3"]
}",
  "stream": false
}
